title: lastrea floridana
intro: Lastrea floridana, commonly known as the Florida fern, is a species of fern native to the southeastern United States. It is a vascular plant with leafy fronds that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The Florida fern is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
